lastSession.summary: Prepared fictional bakery work in queued, active, review, shipped, parked, and owner-decision states.

queue.title: Add a shared dough proofing timer
queue.context: The fictional bakery team currently tracks proofing windows on paper.
queue.userProblem: Bakers cannot see when a batch is ready from the packing station.
queue.desiredOutcome: A visible timer follows each batch through the morning workflow.
queue.scope: Local timer state and an accessible countdown display.
acceptanceCriteria: A baker can start, pause, and reset a batch timer.
Reloading the page preserves the active timer.

queue.title: Improve the packing-station batch display
queue.context: A fictional agent is simplifying the display used during the morning packing run.
queue.userProblem: Dense labels make the next batch difficult to identify at a glance.
queue.desiredOutcome: The next fictional batch and its timer are obvious without opening details.
queue.scope: Accessible row hierarchy and keyboard focus for the local display.
acceptanceCriteria: The next batch is identifiable from the first line.
Keyboard focus remains visible while moving between batches.

queue.title: Review the fictional recipe export
queue.context: The bounded export format is ready for a fictional review pass.
queue.userProblem: The bakery needs a portable summary without exposing private notes.
queue.desiredOutcome: The reviewer can confirm the export contains only the declared fields.
queue.scope: Schema and privacy review of the fictional export.
acceptanceCriteria: The export matches the declared fictional schema.
No local note or machine path appears.
queue.risksTrustConcerns: A review result is not a deployment claim.

queue.title: Ship clearer fictional tray labels
queue.context: The fictional label change was independently checked in a named local artifact.
queue.userProblem: Similar tray labels slowed the morning handoff.
queue.desiredOutcome: Each tray label has a unique short code and readable name.
queue.scope: Fictional tray labels and their accessible text.
acceptanceCriteria: Every fictional tray has a unique code.
The reviewed artifact contains the readable tray name.
queue.risksTrustConcerns: The artifact proves the fixture only, not a real deployment.

queue.title: Explore a fictional supplier sync
queue.context: The idea is intentionally deferred until a safe data boundary is specified.
queue.userProblem: Ingredient updates are entered twice in the fictional workflow.
queue.desiredOutcome: A future spec can describe an explicit read-only import boundary.
queue.outOfScope: Credentials, external writes, ordering, and production data.
acceptanceCriteria: The item remains parked until its data and authority boundaries are specified.
queue.risksTrustConcerns: Do not infer permission to contact or write to a supplier system.

inbox.title: Forecast weekly flour use
inbox.rawNote: Explore a forecast based on the fictional shop's planned batches.

decisions.note: Owner-facing asks admitted by the protocol.

items.title: Choose the morning timer alert
items.humanRequiredReason: Two safe interface choices remain after the fictional prototype review.

humanGate.reason: Two safe interface choices remain after the fictional prototype review.

items.blockedOutcome: The timer demo needs one alert style before the fictional release can proceed.
items.riskIfWrong: A distracting default could make the bakery display harder to use during a busy shift.
items.rollback: Change the alert preference back in the local configuration.
items.workDone: Both choices were prototyped with fictional batch data and checked for keyboard access.
items.question: How should the shared timer announce that a batch is ready?

options.label: Quiet banner
options.tradeoff: Visible and calm, but someone must be looking at the display

options.label: Short bell
options.tradeoff: Noticeable across the room, but it may interrupt a quiet task

items.recommendationReason: The quiet banner is the least disruptive default and remains easy to change.
